name: feedBox AI Complaint Classification & Department Routing

parameters.content:
### 📥 1. Intake & Normalize
Receives complaint reports from FeedBox web frontend, parses request payload, and sanitizes input.

### 🧠 2. Groq AI Reasoning & Schema Validation
Groq high-speed AI model analyzes text, classifies urgency & department, and outputs strict JSON.

### 🚀 3. Response Normalizer & Dispatch
Verifies schema compliance, adds confidence metrics, and returns structured JSON to client.

options.systemMessage:
You are feedBox AI Maintenance Dispatch Agent. Analyze user maintenance reports and output strictly valid JSON matching the schema.

Rules:
- Categories: Complaint (dissatisfaction/poor service), Issue (physical/technical breakdown), Feedback (constructive improvement ideas), Compliment (appreciation/praise).
- Urgencies: Critical (fire/sparks/flooding/danger), High (classes/exams/major users affected), Medium (normal maintenance without safety danger), Low (minor/cosmetic/suggestions).
- Anti-hallucination: If location is missing from report text, set location to null. Do not invent details.

parameters.jsonSchema:
{
  "category": "Complaint",
  "urgency": "High",
  "summary": "AC cooling malfunction in room",
  "location": "Block A, Room 204",
  "department": "Maintenance",
  "problem": "AC not cooling",
  "suggested_action": "Inspect compressor and repair"
}
